items.title: Bournemouth pick up first league victory with win over Sunderland
items.description: Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium to pick up their first league victory of the season and move out of the relegation zone.

items.title: Leeds extend Man Utd's winless run to six games
items.description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin earns a point for Leeds and extends Manchester United's winless run to six games.

items.title: Madueke's strike enough as Arsenal pick up narrow win over Forest
items.description: Noni Madueke comes of the bench to score the winning goal as Arsenal beat Nottingham Forest 1-0 at The City Ground.

items.title: Gomez scores extraordinary goal as Brighton put five past Palace
items.description: Diego Gomez scores a sensational goal from the halfway line as Brighton hammer rivals Crystal Palace.

items.title: 'Maybe we became arrogant' - Sunderland struggles continue
items.description: Sunderland defender Nordi Mukiele suggested the Black Cats may have become "arrogant" as last season's surprise package stutter in the Premier League this term.

items.title: Madueke scores late winner as Arsenal edge past Forest
items.description: Highlights from the Premier League match between Nottingham Forest and Arsenal.

items.title: Shades of Barca and Beckham - Brighton aim to maintain superb start
items.description: With 23 goals in seven Premier League matches, including some stunning strikes, Brighton continue to delight their fans and get them dreaming of what might be.

items.title: Arsenal substitutes change game - Arteta
items.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta says their substitutes changed the game as they beat Nottingham Forest 1-0 in the Premier League.

items.title: Arsenal win with one shot on target as Forest sink into bottom three
items.description: Arsenal's only shot on target proved enough to snatch victory at Nottingham Forest through Noni Madueke's deflected strike, keeping the champions within touching distance of Premier League leaders Manchester City and condemning Forest to the relegation zone.

items.title: Hearts roll out red carpet ... and Celtic walk all over it
items.description: Hearts thought attack was the best form of defence at Celtic Park. They were badly wrong, writes Tom English.

items.title: Long-range goals from further and further out
items.description: After Diego Gomez's halfway-line stunner for Brighton on Sunday, BBC Sport looks at the previous longest-range Premier League goals as recorded by Opta in the last 20 seasons.
